slot_scores.name: contract_full_coverage
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask whether a signed contract must remain active for its full term or whether partial usage is allowed.

slot_scores.name: contract_length_diversity
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether at least two distinct contract lengths must be used.

slot_scores.name: max_distinct_contracts
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask about any cap on the number of distinct contract types.

slot_scores.name: demand_exact_satisfaction
slot_scores.evidence_quote: The required area for each month is a minimum that must be met or exceeded (renting more than required is allowed), or must the rented area match the required area exactly each month?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether monthly demand must be met exactly or whether surplus/shortage is allowed.

slot_scores.name: objective_minimize_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Since the rented area must match the required area exactly each month, is the objective to minimize the total rental cost over the 4 months?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly confirmed the objective is to minimize total rental cost.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: No requirement to use at least two distinct contract lengths; any combination of contract types is allowed.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about contract-length diversity, and the READY_TO_MODEL summary omits any such constraint.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no limit on the number of distinct contract types that can be signed.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a maximum number of distinct contracts, and the final model includes all four contract types without any cap.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: A contract, once signed, is used for its entire coverage period; partial usage is not modeled.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did not ask whether a signed contract must be kept for all months in its term, though the model implicitly treats contract areas as active for the full term.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 contract-length diversity requirement remained unresolved.

summary: The agent clarified several important modeling details, including exact demand satisfaction and the cost-minimization objective, but missed the P1 requirement about using at least two distinct contract lengths and did not ask about contract full-term coverage or the maximum number of distinct contracts.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
